The Azerbaijani Ministry of Defense has released footage unveiling its new single-seat JF-17C Block III Multirole Fighters, bearing tactical numbers 24-501 and 24-502.
The newly formed “Jaguars” squadron is based at the recently modernized Nasosnaya Air Base, formerly home to MiG-25 interceptors, which remain in storage with the Azerbaijani Air Force.
The footage also shows at least four JF-17s parked inside newly constructed hardened aircraft shelters, alongside several Su-25 ground-attack aircraft and L-39 jet trainers.

Denmark and Italy push forward on migration control.
The EU Parliament has voted to back new rules for return hubs outside Europe. This allows faster returns of rejected asylum seekers and irregular migrants to third countries, speeding up deportations and strengthening border management.
Led by efforts from Denmark’s Mette Frederiksen and Italy’s Giorgia Meloni, Europe is moving toward more pragmatic, effective migration policies.
